newsitem.title: CANADA: Edper and Brascan merger approved.
newsitem.headline: Edper and Brascan merger approved.

text.p: Edper Group Ltd and Brascan Ltd said on Thursday that shareholders of both companies approved their merger to form EdperBrascan Corp.

The companies said that under the deal, holders of Edper's class A limited voting shares will receive one class A limited voting share of EdperBrascan, while holders of Brascan's class A shares will receive 1.5 class A limited voting shares of EdperBrascan for each Brascan share.

Edper and Brascan said in a statement that the merger would be effective on August 1 and that shares in the new conglomerate would begin trading on the Toronto, Montreal, American and Brussels stock exchanges afterward under the symbol EBC.
